Thanks again for the demo last week. To keep momentum for the Pilot and the Q3 launch window we sketched a short Mutual Action Plan (attached) that sequences the open legal and procurement dependencies (MSA / DPA / Order Form). Goal: signed order form + DPA by July 9, MSA sign by July 16.

Key asks from your side:
- Confirm primary decision owners for Legal and Procurement (name, email, best contact hours)
- Any internal blackout dates for July (finance/board review weeks) that would block signature windows
- Whether Lifera can run a short security questionnaire (we can accept our standard SIG-lite) in parallel with contract redlines

Attached: needlethread_map_v1.xlsx (walks through milestones, owners, and acceptance criteria). I also attached our current MSA with minor redlines as MSA_redlines_v3.pdf so Lifera legal has a starting point.

If these dates are tight we can propose a fallback: sign MSA with DPA stubbed and complete DPA within 30 days post-signature, or alternatively, approve a pilot order form under standard PO to enable a limited pilot while legal finishes DPA.

Proposed next step: 30-minute MAP sync this Thursday 10:00–10:30 PT to align owners and confirm timeline. Does that work for you?

Eliza / Thomas —

Thanks — I pulled the two attachments and sketched a recommended sequencing below that typically helps us hit an accelerated close while limiting rework for both Legal teams. My assumption: Lifera can turn initial legal comments in ~3 business days and SIG-lite returns in 5 business days.

Proposed sequencing (parallel-first approach):
1) Day 0 (today): Kick MAP + SIG-lite kickoff.
2) Day 1–3: Lifera Legal provides initial redlines to MSA_redlines_v3.pdf. Redwood legal will review and respond within 2 business days.
3) Day 1–7: Security completes SIG-lite — if any high-severity gaps discovered, triage call within 48 hours.
4) Day 4–10: Iterate on DPA language specifically (we propose to treat DPA as priority parallel path).
5) Day 8–12: Order Form finalization (pricing, seats, pilot scope) — Procurement/Finance approval concurrently; if Procurement needs exec sign-off, target July 9 for PO approval.
6) Day 12–16: Final MSA sign-off window; sign MSA with DPA attached or DPA to be signed within 30 days post MSA if unavoidable.

Milestones and owners (high level):
- Lifera Legal (Thomas) -> initial redline by 18 June EOD (as Eliza suggested)
- Lifera Security -> SIG-lite completion by 23 June
- Lifera Procurement -> PO approval by 9 July (or exec sponsor sign-off to allow pilot)
- Redwood Legal (Karthik) -> respond to MSA redline within 2 business days of receipt
- Redwood Sales/AM (Hannah / Laura) -> finalize Order Form content by 25 June

Acceptance criteria for pilot order form: 2–3 seats, non-production dataset, 30-day pilot term, feature set X enabled, early-termination 7-day notice.

If Lifera expects slower turnaround for legal, alternate path is: sign MSA with DPA appendix set to complete within 30 days; procurement can issue PO for pilot concurrently. We should avoid sequential-only approach (legal -> security -> procurement) because that extends the timeline by multiple weeks.

I'll upload a one-page MAP summary to the HubSpot deal and create a DocuSign envelope draft for the order form so procurement can see the mechanics. Links: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/company/67890 and Docusign draft will be posted (placeholder) https://www.docusign.net/envelope/details/ABC123DEF

Hannah — can your team own weekly 30-minute check-ins until signature (Thursdays)? Laura, can you join the calls to handle pilot logistics?

Thanks —
Karthik Iyer
Head, Legal Enablement | Redwood Inference
